levels.title: YAML 1 · Clean Syntax & Formatting Basics
levels.concept_capsule: The YAML 1.2 specification forbids tab characters (\t) for indentation: sibling keys in the same mapping must align cleanly with spaces and start with a # header comment.
levels.reference_solution:
# Service runtime configuration
service: api
port: 8000
env: prod

keywords_glossary.role: Documents the purpose of the configuration manifest at the top of the file.
YAML scalar mapping requiring a space after the colon (: ).
YAML parsers reject tab indentation; root-level sibling keys align at column 0.

formatting_mechanics.indentation: 0 spaces for root-level sibling keys; tab characters (\t) are strictly forbidden.
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: One key: value mapping per line.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: Colon followed by a single space (: ) separating key and value.
formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: Descriptive # comment on the first line of the file.

analogous_example.title: Clean YAML configuration for a Redis cache service
analogous_example.code:
# Cache service runtime configuration
cache: redis
port: 6379
mode: cluster
analogous_example.why_it_works: Starts with a # comment, aligns root keys without tabs, and formats each key: value cleanly.

levels.title: YAML 2 · Edge Cases & Documentation
levels.concept_capsule: In GitHub Actions workflows every nesting level uses strict 2-space multiples (2, 4, 6) and branch lists are formatted as block sequences (- item) for clean Git diffs.
levels.starter_code:
name: Build
on:
  push:
   branches: [main]
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
levels.reference_solution:
# CI workflow for main branch validation
name: Build
on:
  push:
    branches:
      - main
jobs:
  lint:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest

keywords_glossary.role: Workflow trigger hierarchy where each child key indents by exactly 2 spaces.
Formats list items on dedicated lines with a dash and space for readable diffs.
Specifies the job runner environment using 2- and 4-space indentation steps.

formatting_mechanics.indentation: Exact 2-space multiples per nesting depth (0 root, 2 push/lint, 4 branches/runs-on, 6 - main).
formatting_mechanics.line_breaks: Expand inline arrays [main] into multi-line block sequences under their parent key.
formatting_mechanics.punctuation: Dash followed by a single space (- main) for each sequence item.
formatting_mechanics.documentation_standard: Top-line # comment describing the CI workflow purpose.

analogous_example.title: Nightly security workflow YAML with 2-space block sequences
analogous_example.code:
# Nightly security scan workflow
name: Security
on:
  schedule:
    branches:
      - develop
jobs:
  audit:
    runs-on: ubuntu-latest
analogous_example.why_it_works: Uses strict 2-space steps, block sequence - develop, and a descriptive # header comment.
